issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class StockIngredient: the problem statement (UML) declares a 3-argument constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int) and the solution implements a 3-argument constructor, but the template only provides a 4-argument constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean). The template's Main.java also uses the 3-argument form (e.g., new StockIngredient("Bacon", 10, 50)). This inconsistency will cause compilation errors or force students to change the provided example code, blocking them from following the task and matching the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore or add the 3-argument constructor public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity) to the template so it matches the UML, the example in Main, and the solution. Implement it to perform the same validation/initialization as the solution, or provide it as an overload that delegates to the existing 4-argument constructor (e.g., public StockIngredient(String n,int p,int q){ this(n,p,q,false); }). Alternatively, update the problem statement and example code to consistently require the 4-argument constructor, but adding the 3-arg overload to the template is the least disruptive fix for students.
